resources.string: "Track expiry dates and see what needs attention."
"Some data could not load. Use Refresh to try again."
"A successful test only confirms reachability. It does not verify your account or sync."
"Selecting an address pauses sync. Your account stays signed in and nothing uploads automatically."
"Deleted on one side, edited on the other"
"Your data stays on this device. You decide when to sync."
"Export, preview and safely restore local data"
"No server configured. Add one under Server addresses in Settings, then return to sign in."
"Only one account can be signed in. Sign out before changing accounts. Server addresses are managed separately."
"Add, edit, archive and view your records without a network connection."
"The server syncs devices. Your local database remains the source of truth."
"Your local database is the source of truth. The server only syncs devices."
"Keep editing locally. A conflict only pauses its affected record."
"Nearby changes are combined before sending. Manual sync is always available."
"Runs approximately at the selected interval, subject to network and battery restrictions."
"Network and battery restrictions may delay background sync"
"This server cannot verify your account. Sign out under Account in Settings, then sign in again. Changing addresses never clears your account automatically."
"Sign in to preview and enable sync"
"Pause network sync and keep editing locally"
"Test the exact address before adding or changing it. Tests never sign in or upload data."
"Review and enable sync after signing in. Signing in never uploads local data automatically."
"Only conflicting records pause. Other assets and items continue syncing."
"If a record changes on both sides, both versions are kept here for you to choose."
"Compare the fields, then choose how to resolve the record."
"This is an ownership or permission conflict, not a deleted record. Other accounts’ data is never shown."
"The protocol provides no verified edit times for both sides. Device time is never used to pick a version automatically."
"Use the local version. You will be prompted again if the remote version changes."
"Replace this local record with the remote version."
"Save the edited version as a copy"
"Keep the remote version and save local edits as a copy. For deletion conflicts, keep the deletion and save the edits separately."
"Complete local JSON, including archived assets and expiry items. No account credentials."
"Validate the file and preview record counts first. After confirmation, a safety backup is created before restoring. Failures preserve existing data."
"Mark upcoming expiry dates in the item list."
"This controls in-app expiry status. It does not enable system notifications."
"Track assets, calculate ownership costs and manage expiry dates. Data stays local, with optional sync between devices."

"A safety backup is created first. Local data will sync to the target above. Changing servers resets the sync baseline; differences for matching IDs require your choice. Account details are retained. Sign out first if the new server cannot verify your account."
"File validation passed. Confirming replaces local data after creating a safety backup."
"Only the connection is removed. Account, local data and sync history are retained. Removing the selected address pauses sync without selecting another address."
"The edited version is saved as a copy, keeping both versions."
"The unselected version is replaced. Only this record is affected."
"A safety backup is created before restoring the selected file. This replaces local records."
"Network sync stops. Local data and pending edits are retained. Sign in to review and enable sync to a new target."
"Start with one tool and grow your personal workflow."
"Tools have their own entry. Expiry summaries also appear on the overview for quick access."
"This item has unsaved changes. Leaving discards them."
"“%1$s” cannot be restored from the list after deletion. Synced devices will be notified during the next sync."
"Track expiry dates and view upcoming or expired items in the app."
"No matching items. Tap + to add one."
"Provide both the opened date and validity period, or leave both blank. Dates are validated on save."
"Record the things you use and understand their cost per day."
"This form has unsaved changes. Leaving discards them."
"Unable to load asset. Check your connection and server address, then retry."
"Zero and up to two decimal places are supported. Save a blank value to clear it. Unarchive before editing other fields."
"Held days and cost per day include the retirement date."
"Clear the retirement date and calculate held days and cost per day from purchase through today."
"Archived assets are excluded from everyday lists and totals. Data is retained and can be restored from Archived."
"Restore its previous lifecycle status and include it in asset lists and the overview again."
